task: W11 PostgreSQL 16 tiny synthetic fixture smoke
scope: 16 native business-row synthetic cases only; no CSV, Docker, full build or lifecycle

resource_decision.classification: small targeted check, not heavy/full-fixture execution
resource_decision.initdb_probe_caveat: initdb --set overrides were supplied, but its captured default-detection banner still says max_connections 100 and shared_buffers 128MB. No long-running server was started with those defaults; effective own server settings were independently verified as 5 and 8MB. Transient initdb probe memory was not measured.
resource_decision.memory_measurement_limit: The recorded 13,520 KiB RSS is an idle postmaster snapshot only, not combined cluster memory or peak RSS. The 128 MiB pre-run estimate is not a measured or enforced ceiling.
